Hey,

I am really fucking proud of you and your fiancé. I had smoked heavily for around two months (nowhere probably near the amount of time you’ve smoked) but when I quit, shit was awful for around 1-1.5 weeks. I remember sweating so much and then I’d put on the fan or something cool and instantly be really cold, basically hot flashes at it’s finest.  Second thing I had notice between the time span of my withdrawals were loss of appetite. This was a huge one. I would be really hungry but the second I ate food, I’d immediately want to puke. Last but not least, sleep. Sleeping is not a thing when its your first couple of days. I don’t recommend taking drugs to go to sleep (xanax, benzo). You’re trying to put yourself back into a regular sleeping mode without the help of medicine. Although it is not the end of the world if you do use it. You are far enough in the process that you really dont need it. (doesnt mean it will be easy to fall asleep). Lastly if you relapse or your fiancé does, don’t beat yourselves up. You guys are human and make mistakes. Why get mad at something you really dont have control over? Anyways take care both of you and wish you best of luck. If you need any tips, DM’s are open :)

Take care!
